# seerr_job_run (Resource)

Trigger an operational job execution via `/api/v1/settings/jobs/{jobId}/run`. Optionally cancel in-flight job execution on destroy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String) The ID string of the job to run (e.g. `plex-sync`, `user-import`, `radarr-sync`).

### Optional

- `cancel_on_delete` (Boolean) If true, destroying this resource will call `/api/v1/settings/jobs/{jobId}/cancel` to attempt cancelling an in-flight job execution.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of values (such as timestamps or hashes) that, when changed, will re-trigger the job execution.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
